objective: Turn dispersed historical and current documents into a small, provenance-preserving research synthesis without making another documentation pile.
discovery_roots: every directory named docs, handoff, or handoffs beneath archive/

pipeline.action: Enumerate candidate files, hashes, formats, repository history, and obvious document relationships without treating any content as true.
Assign each candidate a source class, likely catalogue destinations, priority, and one intake disposition.
Register the exact selected bytes and hash. A changed file becomes a new source version and schedules review of claims derived from the old hash.
Extract atomic observations, decisions, hypotheses, questions, procedures, limitations, and supersession statements with exact source locators and temporal scope.
Compare each claim with registered evidence and current Mission Hub authority. Record support, contradiction, supersession, or unresolved status per claim rather than per document.
Update only affected consolidated wiki catalogues in one bounded change; append one operation-log receipt.
Run schema, citation, link, source-hash, contradiction, and stale-derived-claim checks. On failure, publish nothing and retain the queue item.

priority_order: current campaign goals, findings, and immutable artifacts
current research policy, methods, materials, and evaluation contracts
architecture knowledge and supported campaign findings
anti_sprawl_rules: Do not create one wiki page per source.
Do not create a second handoff summary.
Do not copy an entire source into the wiki.
Do not classify an entire mixed document as authoritative or false when its claims have different dispositions.
Keep source queues and claim packets structured; keep human synthesis in the existing consolidated wiki pages.
Campaign goals and findings remain the only per-campaign Markdown exception.
A source file remains evidence even after its useful claims are synthesized; never rewrite historical evidence to match current understanding.

luna_may: record explicit and evidence-backed relationships between claims
mark a claim unresolved or review_due
luna_must_not: promote a hypothesis into a finding without evidence
infer live state from an old document
create facts to complete an intake batch
